programme.title: 第2集 - 追趕進度
programme.desc: 夏季豪雨結束, 裴勒提爾伐木公司總算能將木材運往製材廠。由於進度落後, 艾爾登決定讓運材卡車加掛拖車, 將運量加倍。但是運量加倍, 危險也加倍, 引發卡車司機質疑。艾爾登親自上陣測試, 證明雙拖車沒問題。但是雙拖車實際上路第一天, 就因為裝載員失手戳破卡車輪胎, 讓卡車少跑一趟。另外伐木作業也頻出狀況。重要的集材機故障, 作業被迫中斷兩天, 木材無法運出。接著集材機操作員戴維因血糖過低而神智不清, 幸好節目攝影師懂得如何處理, 救了戴維一命。但是戴維的厄運並未結束。他的家失火燒毀, 一切化為烏有。總計裴勒提爾公司本週又是赤字。唯一值得慶幸的是艾爾登代表家族參加卡車拉力賽獲勝。不過慶祝之後, 裴勒提爾家族隨即又要為公司存亡而努力。

programme.title: 第3集 - 颶風搗亂
programme.desc: 時序進入秋季, 裴勒提爾公司面臨天氣的挑戰。原本潮濕的秋季, 這年雨量更是往常的兩倍, 使得道路泥濘不堪, 滿載沈重原木的卡車稍有不慎就會發生意外。一輛包商卡車因為超載, 轉彎時原木散落地面, 造成黃金林道交通堵塞, 也延誤木材載運進度。接著颶風凱爾襲擊緬因州, 伐木與載運作業被迫中斷。眼看產量嚴重縮水, 艾爾登和魯迪只能接受虧損的現實。直到週四, 林地終於重新開放, 裴勒提爾公司趕緊將機具移往新的林地, 進行採伐。在此同時, 伐木作業的生力軍報到: 一部瑞典製造的集運機。由於試車順利, 魯迪期望天氣好轉後, 集運機能協助公司趕上產量進度。另一方面, 大哥丹尼幾個月前開卡車時受傷, 至今尚未痊癒, 也讓裴勒提爾公司損失一員大將。

programme.title: Overhaulin' S5E1 -Brushtang
programme.desc: These vehicles mean a lot more to their owners than a pile of metal. Join these car lovers as they recover their long lost loved ones or find new loves.

programme.title: 第1集 - 野馬重生
programme.desc: 第五季第一集, 從本季起節目型態有大幅變動, 車主不再被蒙在鼓裡, 不再被捉弄, 而是從頭就知道他的車要接受改造, 只是不知道會變成什麼模樣。本集車主麥特有一輛1965年的福特野馬, 他的哥哥為答謝麥特在他罹癌期間的悉心照顧, 為他的車報名, 由奇普和改造大隊進行為期七天的變身大改造。奇普以麥特喜歡的墨綠色為底, 加上銀色橘邊的賽車條紋, 最特別的是以特殊海綿在銀漆和所有金屬零件上刷出霧面橫紋, 增加質感。ARC音響組裝了華麗又具震撼力的頂級音響, 配上450匹馬力的福特賽車引擎, 卡茲金內裝廠製作的全新皮料豪華內裝。焦急等待的麥特, 看到愛車變得煥然一新, 大呼不可思議, 並將備份鑰匙交給哥哥, 兩人共享這輛重獲新生的野馬。

programme.desc: Cotten challenges the guys to some front-wheel-drive, teenage-antics-style racing. They replace the rear wheels of three cheap cars with metal skids.

programme.title: 第5集 - 前驅賽車
programme.desc: 費尼根、考頓和紐本這回比的賽車不同於以往。所謂下護板賽車是將前驅車的後輪胎替換成鋼製護板, 再開上柏油路面拖行, 除了火花四射, 失控甩尾打滑更是家常便飯。穩定駕馭本來就不容易, 更別說搞笑三人組素來愛改裝破車, 上場後會鬧出什麼怪事?

programme.title: Flying Wild Alaska S1E1 -Meet The Twetos
programme.desc: In the Alaskan town of Unalakleet, the Twetos and their family-run airline battle the elements to transport supplies to some of the most inaccessible areas on the planet.

programme.title: 第1集 - 提多這一家
programme.desc: 吉姆載送獵人到起降困難的山脊上, 回程時竟然發現方向舵失靈。

programme.title: American Loggers S1E3 -Hurricane On The Horizon
programme.desc: A hurricane makes for the Pelletiers' most disastrous week of production yet. Rain and mud slow tree cutting down and create danger on the roads.

programme.title: 第3集 - 颶風搗亂
programme.desc: 時序進入秋季, 裴勒提爾公司面臨天氣的挑戰。原本潮濕的秋季, 這年雨量更是往常的兩倍, 使得道路泥濘不堪, 滿載沈重原木的卡車稍有不慎就會發生意外。一輛包商卡車因為超載, 轉彎時原木散落地面, 造成黃金林道交通堵塞, 也延誤木材載運進度。接著颶風凱爾襲擊緬因州, 伐木與載運作業被迫中斷。眼看產量嚴重縮水, 艾爾登和魯迪只能接受虧損的現實。直到週四, 林地終於重新開放, 裴勒提爾公司趕緊將機具移往新的林地, 進行採伐。在此同時, 伐木作業的生力軍報到: 一部瑞典製造的集運機。由於試車順利, 魯迪期望天氣好轉後, 集運機能協助公司趕上產量進度。另一方面, 大哥丹尼幾個月前開卡車時受傷, 至今尚未痊癒, 也讓裴勒提爾公司損失一員大將。

programme.desc: 本集美味秘訣升級版, 主持人回顧過去於1999年介紹雞蛋的集數。向觀眾解釋雞蛋的分級、內部構造, 以及三種蛋料理的改良烹調方式－煎蛋、炒蛋, 以及水煮蛋。主持人也指出, 90年代時人們普遍認為, 食用生雞蛋會導致沙門氏菌感染, 但現在的雞蛋經過消毒, 不再需要擔心。

programme.desc: Big lumps of crabmeat are the secret to Rachael Ray's Carbonara with Crab.

programme.title: 第13集 - 培根蛋麵
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡, 瑞秋的老公約翰來到節目上跟她一起下廚, 約翰要負責用琴酒、金巴利、紅苦艾酒及苦精等食材調出內格羅尼酒, 同時瑞秋也著手製作約翰最愛的培根蛋麵, 但這回會稍有變化, 加入帝王蟹腳肉, 做成蟹肉蛋麵。不過在蟹肉下鍋之前, 得先動手檢查蟹肉裡是否有碎殼或軟骨。瑞秋也示範如何用富含澱粉的鹹煮麵水為蛋黃及乳酪調溫, 做出培根蛋麵該有的黏稠度, 調好的醬汁加上甘甜的蟹肉, 加點新英格蘭風味的老灣調味料, 最後再撒上切碎的芹菜葉來為菜餚畫龍點睛, 這道菜的滋味令瑞秋跟約翰連聲叫好。

programme.title: 30 Minute Meals S28E14 -A Cutlet Above
programme.desc: Rachael Ray reinvents the everyday pork cutlet with her Pork Tonkatsu with Shiso and Savoy.

programme.title: 第14集 - 肉排料理
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡, 瑞秋要做日式炸豬排, 她發現只要做成肉片, 無論是酥炸肉排或帕瑪乳酪烤雞排, 往往都會大獲好評。她先開始使用烏斯特黑醋、番茄醬、醬油、芥末粉、蒜粒與味醂調製出美味可口的醬汁, 接著準備好裹料的烤盤, 把豬腰肉排打扁後裹上日式麵包粉、蛋液及芝麻, 用中性油下鍋炸得酥香可口, 淋上已經做好的醬汁, 讓她免了去日式餐廳排對外帶回家吃的麻煩, 在家就能享用這道美食。她接著把皺葉甘藍切絲, 加上蘿蔔片與紫蘇絲, 做了一道速成的沙拉, 淋上溜醬油及蜂蜜做成的醬汁, 味道非常甘甜。

programme.title: 第14集 - 逃離帕奇曼監獄

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner S3E24 -America's Lost Treasures

programme.title: 第24集 - 美國的失落寶藏
programme.desc: 數百年來, 一直有美國各地藏有大量寶藏的傳說。失竊的黃金、海盜搶劫、殺人復仇的故事--但這些關於失落寶藏的傳說是否太荒謬了?

programme.title: The Unbelievable With Dan Aykroyd S2E2 -It Came From Above
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered about the most bizarre things that have fallen from the sky? From meteorites to seafood and even bathtubs, these are some truly unbelievable stories of what comes from above.

programme.title: 第2集 - 天降異物
programme.desc: 你是否曾經好奇, 天上掉下來的東西裡, 最奇怪最怪異的會是什麼呢?從隕石砸落, 到海鮮從天而降, 甚至還有浴缸掉落下來, 這些全都是難以想像的故事。天空中降下的事物, 往往超乎常理, 讓人既驚訝又困惑。

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo S2E10 -Deadliest Discoveries

programme.title: 第10集 - 致命發現

programme.title: Alone S12E7 -Echoes Of Emptiness

programme.title: 第7集 - 虛空迴響

programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. programme.title: Sinkhole
programme.desc: An ordinary office worker Dong-won (KIM Sung-kyun) and his family move into a house he bought after years of saving. Overwhelmed with happiness, he invites his colleagues to a housewarming party, but heavy overnight rain leads to a gigantic sinkhole, and in a mere minute, it swallows up the entire apartment and the people inside. Hundreds of meters down the hole, Dong-won, his neighbor Man-su (CHA Seoung-won), and the unfortunate housewarming party guests must find their way out. Rain starts to pour down, filling the sinkhole with water, giving them very little time to get back to the surface.

programme.title: 2gether: The Movie
programme.desc: Tine Mr. Chic, a cheeky good-looking university student, finds himself in big trouble after being romantically and aggressively chased by Green, a handsome guy. To push Green away, Tine asks Sarawat, the hottest guy on campus, to pretend to flirt with him. Little does he know that there is not even a shred of pretense in Sarawat's flirt. Not to Tine's knowledge, a few years ago, Sarawat met Tine at a Scrubb concert and fell for Tine ever since. That is how a fake flirt operation becomes true love for Sarawat and Tine whose story is told through hit songs by Scrubb.

programme.title: Grand Maison Paris
programme.desc: After their restaurant 'Grand Maison Tokyo' earned a Michelin three-star, Natsuki Obana and Rinko Hayami venture to Paris to open 'Grand Maison Paris,' aiming to become the first Asian chefs to achieve the same honor. However, they face cultural challenges and intense pressure in a city filled with culinary masters. Following a mishap at a gala dinner, Obana makes a pact with his former mentor: he will leave France if they don't earn three stars in the next Michelin evaluation. Can Obana and his team overcome these obstacles to achieve their dream?

programme.title: Café Midnight: Missing Honey
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom?

programme.title: Love The Way You Are
programme.desc: It's a romantic comedy between the next door neighbors Lin-lin Chou and Yu-ke Fang, who have totally opposite school performances. While Lin-lin struggles to pass the exams, Yu-ke gets the highest score in every of them. Just when Lin-lin supposes she is finally going to say good-bye to Yu-ke after high school graduation, they get accepted by the same department – department of animal husbandry, the most unpopular department of the most popular university. To fix Yu-ke's “First love trauma” she accidentally caused, Lin-lin tries everything to help him chase back his first love, the queen bee of the school. However, Lin-lin herself also gradually falls for Yu-ke during the process. What should Lin-lin do with her feelings? What is actually going on in Yu-ke's mind? The graduation season is around the corner, this is a story for you to call back your first love memory.

programme.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
programme.desc: Something strange has happened to Makoto Konno. Time has suddenly stopped and moved her backwards. With her newly discovered ability to literally leap backwards in time Makoto finds that tests become a piece of cake, embarrassing situations are corrected and she can have her favorite food anytime she wants. Unfortunately her carefree time traveling has adverse effects on the people she cares for. With every successful leap Makoto somehow alters the fate of those around her. This was not supposed to happen and as she races back in time to fix everything, she notices that her abilities are not limitless but with every successful jump she is one step closer to discovering the most wonderful secret in her young adult life.

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t

programme.title: Movie Craftsmen -Ceci Fok
programme.desc: Ceci Fok, the art director of the film “Night King”, unveils how Hong Kong filmmakers create boundless imagination with limited resources, deeply deconstructing how to construct unique visual aesthetics in different film genres, the process of collecting props for the film, and how tedious work is transformed into endless fun, silently building passionate artistic dream brick by brick behind the scene.

programme.title: Acting's No Kidding: Band Four
programme.desc: “Band Four” is the story of Cat aspiring to make her mark on the global music stage, while contending with the haunting absence of her father, King, a guitarist who abandoned her and her mother two decades ago. Cat's life takes a dramatic turn when her mother succumbs to illness, and King unexpectedly appears at the funeral together with Matilda, Cat's previously unknown adolescent stepsister, further complicating Cat's ongoing struggle to raise her own 9-year-old son, Riley. Forced to live together in a crowded Hong Kong flat, the newly reunited family finds itself in a vortex of conflicting personalities, insecurities, and priorities. The family finds amidst this turmoil a common communication channel via music. Just as the familial bond begins to form through their shared musical language, both their bond and Band Four's survival are put to the test by a fresh set of unforeseen challenges.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E280 -Pass and Goal
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Dai Yichen, the Shanghai-based mastermind of a massive financial fraud who has been on the run for seven years, resurfaces in Paris, France. Chinese economic crime detective Ye Jun leads the 'Fox Hunt Team' on a cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets. The former swindler, who embezzled billions of yuan, has now ascended to the overseas high society, while the life savings of tens of thousands of people have been completely destroyed, leading to ruined families and countless tragedies. The flow of the illicit funds remains a mystery, with street chases, human bombs, and traps set by villains at every turn-each step is a struggle for survival! When the hunter becomes the hunted, can the Fox Hunt Team make a comeback against all odds? A hundred-million-yuan fraud, a cross-border manhunt!

programme.title: Aces Go Places
programme.desc: The Mafia is concluding a secret deal in Hong Kong when the loot to be handed over, a consignment of valuable diamonds, is stolen by someone who left a white glove. Based on this clue, the police thinks that it is the work of the infamous international thief 'White Glove'. Interpol is contacted and an ace detective, Baldy, is sent from New York to investigate. He is assisted by a local woman inspector known for her toughness. They start on a wrong footing initially but grow to be very fond of one another...

programme.title: Fist Of Fury
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised...

programme.title: Heaven Can Help
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting...

programme.title: Swordsman
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity...

programme.title: The Haunted Cop Shop
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: Fantasy Romance
programme.desc: Leung Chiu Wei and Willy were cartoonists. One day when they were on the way to office, they knocked down a lady-ghost Joey Wong. Joey's spirit was thus thrown into the human world. Joey knew nothing as it was the first time she came to a mundane environment. At this time, she met another demoness – Deanie Yip. Yip and her son were sentenced to death by village people because of adultery. Yip didn't do it but nobody believed her. Yip's only hope was to make her son revive from death. Thus when Yip met Willy, she selfishly kept herself and her son inspired by Willy's human spirit. She also intended to hurt Wei the same as well. Since Joey had fallen in love with Wei, she helped Wei to get away from Yip. Joey became weaker and weaker being hurt by Wei's flourishing human vitality. Wei and Joey in fact were lovers in their previous lives...

programme.title: Police Story
programme.desc: Police officer Jackie is the hero in a police crackdown on drug king Chee. But Chee is set free on lack of evidence while Jackie is demoted. Chee, however, wants Jackie dead....

programme.title: 1995 Collections: The Case Of The Cold Fish
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Michael Wong
programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor?

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: Five years have passed since the events of the first God of Gamblers film. Ko Chun is now living a peaceful retirement on his French estate with his pregnant wife Wan Yau, while his disciples Knife and Sing have become world-renowned in their own right. Chun declines repeated challenges from other top-ranked gamblers, having given up gambling in favor of the quiet life. Chun's friend and former bodyguard, Lung Wu, the 'God Of Guns', comes to pay him a visit. While the two are away from the house for a friendly shooting competition, Chau Siu-Chee, a Taiwanese gambler and the world's number one contender to Ko Chun's title, arrives and murders his wife and unborn son in order to goad Chun into a gambling match. After a shootout with Chau Siu-Chee's henchmen, Ko Chun arrives to discover his wife dying. With her last breath, she asks Chun to promise that he will not gamble or admit his real identity for one year, in the hopes that he will not lose his life in an impulsive act of

programme.title: Tiger and Crane E17
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: The Truth Within E18
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: Nothing but You E15
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: Twenty Your Life On 2 E5
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Gareth Southgate S1E4 -Gareth Southgate
programme.desc: In Bear’s Mission with Gareth Southgate, the leader of the Three Lions squad will swap the football field for some of the UK’s toughest terrain and tackle the ultimate challenge, as he joins Bear on a mission across the wilds of Dartmoor.

programme.title: Making Pandas S1E1
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast. Over 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. The team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E15 -Giant Jungle Frog, Cheetah Encounter & Alligator Feeding Frenzy!

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 S1E1 -The Force of Nature
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Our Golden Days (Bilingual) E66
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦。

programme.title: The Inner Eye (Bilingual) E13
programme.desc: 「常勝律師」唐盈盈（辛芷蕾飾）與頂頭上司康俊（林雨申飾）在一樁樁眾生百態的案件中過招，在碰撞中釐清中國式「人情與法理」難題，並最終收穫自身成長的動人故事。

programme.title: Bloody Flower (Bilingual) E8
programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星？

programme.title: Today's Webtoon (Bilingual) E1
programme.desc: 講述柔道選手出身的女主角溫心（金世正飾），因傷被迫放棄當運動員，轉職網絡漫畫編輯，揭開人生新一頁的同時，亦反映韓國網絡漫畫業界激烈競爭的情况。​

programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦。

programme.title: The Inner Eye (Bilingual) E14
programme.desc: 「常勝律師」唐盈盈（辛芷蕾飾）與頂頭上司康俊（林雨申飾）在一樁樁眾生百態的案件中過招，在碰撞中釐清中國式「人情與法理」難題，並最終收穫自身成長的動人故事。

programme.title: Bloody Flower (Bilingual) E9
programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星？

programme.title: Today's Webtoon (Bilingual) E1
programme.desc: 講述柔道選手出身的女主角溫心（金世正飾），因傷被迫放棄當運動員，轉職網絡漫畫編輯，揭開人生新一頁的同時，亦反映韓國網絡漫畫業界激烈競爭的情况。​

programme.title: The Empire (Bilingual) E10
programme.desc: 講述的是夢想世襲的韓國最高法官貴族們的醜聞，以及人性與貪婪的故事。​
